title: To the Perilous Rail
text:
Walkthrough

As you are riding the minecart, you will observe a ladder. Once you reach it, jump and climb it, run to the right, and jump over the buzzsaw.

The cart will eventually stop at some point, and press a button providing electrical charge to a rail. Pull it out, and jump ahead of it. Push it to just below the rail, then climb the cart and rail, and then finally, run to the right before the cart strikes the button again.
